scope: Maintainer-requested independent rerun, expanded before capture to all six workloads after the question about the other data. Exact original candidate; no new policy or diagnostic captures. No pooling with either earlier cohort.
configuration: Fresh local ext4 databases; v7 Parallel,1KiB values,2GiB SST,no compaction. Batch64 uses750000 puts/sample10;point8/16 use100000/sample100;point1 uses20000/sample10. Reuse byte-identical saved baseline and candidate binaries.
schedule: All six cells run regardless of interim performance. Batch16 and point8 each have2 warmups+5 alternating pairs;point1,point16,batch8,batch1 each have2 warmups+3 pairs. Exactly56 invocations:12 warmups+44 scored. No replacement pairs, pooling or score-selected extra runs. Stop on capture or audit errors.
cooldown: 60s before every cell and15s between invocations; no overlapping builds/tests/profiles/source edits or SSD health polling.
stall_policy: Unchanged: exclude whole pair if either arm mean FRONTIER write>=1ms OR mean fdatasync>=1.5ms. Preserve every raw invocation. This aggregate mask misses short outliers and cannot establish stall-free conditions or source/environment attribution.
assessment: Batch16 needs>=3 matched pairs; other guards>=2. Guard paired and arm-median throughput>=0.95 and paired p99<=1.10. Independent point8 confirmation needs>=3 pairs, paired and arm-median throughput>1 and paired p99<1. Identical DATA bytes. CPU/RSS diagnostic. Retain only if all six cells complete and pass; otherwise baseline source and canonical executable stay unchanged.
validation: No source changes or new builds/tests before the rerun. Verify all128 live inputs against the retained baseline, both saved binaries against original build provenance, and the archived candidate focused49/full1975 and retained1973 checks from the immediately preceding retry. If all performance checks pass, apply the exact saved patch and run fresh correctness checks before retaining it.
publication: Accepted source gets its own local commit; evidence separate. Otherwise evidence only, with live baseline/executable verified unchanged. No push/PR; stop for review.
